cases.title: Discard password after selecting Never For This Site
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password when Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Save and present multiple usernames and passwords
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Pick up new password after password change for a saved website
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Disable password manager and verify saving and prefilling behavior
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in password manager through preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, this information can be viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a site, prevent autofill, and remove from password manager
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a given site are removed, it shall no longer autofill on that site nor shall it be listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill and nothing being listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements (R-102 through R-108) have corresponding test cases covering their explicitly stated behaviors without any coverage gaps, blockers, or redundant excess.
All requirements have corresponding test cases covering their explicit states and operations. No blockers or missing scenario gaps found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement R-102 contains multiple distinct behaviors: discard password and select Never For This Site. R-103 contains multiple distinct behaviors: save multiple usernames and passwords, and present those choices later. R-104 contains multiple distinct behaviors: save a username and password, change the password later, and pick up the new password. R-105 contains multiple distinct behaviors: disable password manager from preferences, stop asking to save passwords, and stop prefilling info on sites. R-106 is a simple declaration regarding viewing saved information in the password manager through preferences, warranting only a single Normal test scenario. R-107 contains multiple distinct behaviors: remove a username and password for a site, prevent autofill on that site, and remove the entry from the password manager list. R-108 contains multiple distinct behaviors: remove all username and password information, prevent autofill entirely, and ensure nothing is listed in the password manager.
